overview: Granby counted 69,025 residents in the 2021 Census, up 4.2 percent from 66,222 in 2016. They live in 31,850 occupied dwellings across 152.69 square kilometres, where a compact downtown around Lac Boivin gives way to suburbs, an industrial park and countryside.

Manufacturing is the backbone, with strengths in aeronautics, specialty vehicles and food processing, and the city also draws summer visitors to its zoo. For a local business, that means a stable, working customer base, demand from manufacturers for services and supplies, and a seasonal lift from tourism.
